name: Vitamin D Deficiency
overview: Vitamin D Deficiency is a health condition that requires individualized medical assessment. Symptoms, causes, and treatment vary by person — consult a qualified doctor in India for diagnosis and a care plan tailored to your history and local guidelines.
symptoms: From a clinical perspective, vitamin D deficiency or hypovitaminosis D is a vitamin D level that is below normal.
In routine practice, vitamin D deficiency can also be caused by inadequate nutritional intake of vitamin D.
In routine practice, disorders that limit vitamin D absorption.
From a clinical perspective, and disorders that impair the conversion of vitamin D to active metabolites, including certain liver, kidney, and hereditary disorders.
